caption:
Chocolate Protein Pancakes
high protein | meal prep friendly | no refined sugar | no maida 

Nutrition: 
C: 52 | F: 14 | P: 42
Calories: 484 for 4 pancakes
Makes 4 pancakes (2 each)

Ingredients:
2 eggs
1 bananas
1/4 cup oats 
1 scoop Fast&Up Plant Protein in chocolate flavor
1/2 teaspoons vanilla extract

optional: 1/4 tsp baking powder

Method:

In a blender, blitz together eggs, banana and oats then add in Fast&Up Plant Protein and vanilla extract and blend till combined.

If needed, add in 30 ml milk to thin it out.

In a non stick pan, add in a heaping ladle of batter and allow to cook on one side then flip it over and cook
do not flip the pancakes again and again as it can end up making it dense 

Pro Tip:

You can easily make the batter the night prior and whip up the pancakes quick in the morning. Top these with anything you like - honey, peanut butter even vanilla yogurt does nicely. The pancakes can be cooked and stored in the fridge for 2-3 days reheating in the microwave
